translations.web: For a woman, whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.
translations.bsb: Instead, a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit soon heard about Jesus, and she came and fell at His feet.
translations.kjv: For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:
translations.asv: But straightway a woman, whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.
